caption:
3 moves that actually lower your tax.

1. Salary sacrifice to super. It goes in before tax and is taxed at 15% in the fund, not your marginal rate. The catch: it's locked away until preservation age and counts toward the $32,500 concessional cap (2026–27).

2. The $1,000 standard deduction. From your 2026–27 return, wage earners get up to $1,000 for work-related expenses with no receipts. Spent more than that on work? Claim your actual costs instead, with records.

3. Union and professional association fees are claimed separately, on top of the standard deduction.

Which one are you using? Tell us in the comments.
